text:
Lindqvist Dairy is recalling its soft cheese after routine testing found Listeria contamination, the Northvale Regional Food Authority announced on 14 March 2025.

Dr. Henrik Voss, Head of Food Safety at the authority, confirmed the recall when I reached him by phone. He said 12,400 units were affected across 86 retail locations.

The recall rests on Northvale Food Authority Recall Notice NFA-2025-0314, a copy of which I reviewed. The notice was issued after the contamination was detected during routine testing.

Dr. Voss told me shoppers who have bought Lindqvist Dairy soft cheese should check the product against the notice. I did not speak to anyone at Lindqvist Dairy before publication. The Gazette will report further details as they become available.
